description.value: The study investigated functional and structural abnormalities associated with cocaine dependence during monetary incentive processing, using fMRI, voxel-based morphometry, and voxel-based fractional anisotropy.

spans.text: In the present study, we wished to investigate the hyperactive reward circuit hypothesis of cocaine addiction by testing meso-cortico-limbic functional sensitivity to non-drug incentives.
